title: Kingman crash was 'the one they walked away from'
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Kingman crash was 'the one they walked away from', about unspecified (told at SOL conference about two years earlier) at Kingman, Arizona; SOL conference, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So this girl that I I have contact with was sitting right near one of the main people. I say who it is, but one of the main people. And as that came up, he said, "That's not right. That's not right. That was that crash. That's the one they walked away from."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says a woman he knows was at a conference called SOL, sitting near one of the event's main people, when a crash said to have happened near Kingman, Arizona came up in connection with a film by James Fox. According to Cameron, the man said: "That's not right. That was that crash. That's the one they walked away from." If true, it would mean the beings aboard a crashed craft survived and left on their own.
